# Configuration rules

`SaaSiCatModule.forRoot()` checks its options against the rules below before it
assembles anything, and reports **every** violation at once rather than the first.
A failing boot names each rule by id and links back to this page.

This file is generated from `PLATFORM_RULES` in
`@saasicat/nest/platform`. Change the rule, not the page.

There are 18 rules, in 11 areas.

## core

### core.adapters-bound

The core adapters are missing: mfa, audit, rlsBypass. Bind them through
`persistence: prismaPersistence({ client })` or one by one through `adapters`.

## catalog

### catalog.identity-or-sink

No plan catalogue is reachable. Either set `planCatalog` (the quickstart YAML
path) or, for DB hydration, BOTH a `planCatalogReadSink` (via `adapters` or
`persistence`) AND `dbCatalog` ({ path: 'config/saas.yaml' }, the file the
settings are read from). Without the file the app boots with a silently empty
catalogue and no settings.

### catalog.db-catalog-names-the-file

`dbCatalog` names the file: `dbCatalog: { path: 'config/saas.yaml' }`. It used
to take `app`, `currency`, `vatRate` and `tenantBilling` as values, and that was
a second place a setting could live. Delete the values here; the platform reads
them from the file it names — the same one they were forwarded from. See
docs/guides/upgrade-to-1.0.md.

### catalog.db-catalog-file-loads

`dbCatalog` names 'config/saas.yaml' and the file did not load. A relative path
is resolved against the directory the process was started in, not against the
file the option is written in. See docs/guides/wire-the-backend.md.

### catalog.app-is-named

The catalogue names no application. `app.name` is the one place an installation
names itself — it is the manifest display name, the login-page brand and the
discovery snapshot key — so an absent one is not a default to fill in: the app
would boot identified by an empty string. Set `app: { name: … }` in
config/saas.yaml.

### catalog.requires-persistence

Catalog is enabled, but `persistence.catalog` is missing. Use a complete
persistence bundle, or wire `CatalogModule` directly.

## admin-resources

### admin-resources.requires-persistence

AdminResources is enabled, but `persistence.adminResources` is missing. Use a
complete persistence bundle, or pass your own `adminResources.resources`.

## promo-codes

### promo-codes.requires-persistence-and-transactions

PromoCodes requires `persistence.promo` and a transactionRunner; missing:
persistence.promo, transactionRunner. Redeeming a code writes two rows and must
not half-apply.

### promo-codes.public-preview-requires-first-time-check

The public promo preview is mounted but has no `firstTimeCustomerCheck`, so
every first-time-only code would preview as unavailable. Pass one, or set
`promoCodes.includePublicController: false`.

## setup

### setup.requires-provisioning-port

Setup is enabled, but no provisioningPort is available. Set
`setup.provisioningPort` or use a bundle providing
`persistence.core.superAdminProvisioning`.

## admin-stats

### admin-stats.requires-audit-stats-port

AdminStats is enabled, but no auditStatsPort is available. Set
`adminStats.auditStatsPort` or use a bundle providing
`persistence.core.auditStats`.

## subscription-contract

### subscription-contract.requires-repository

SubscriptionContract is enabled, but no repository is available. Set
`subscriptionContract.subscriptionContractRepository` or use a compatible
persistence bundle.

## tenant-billing

### tenant-billing.requires-ports

TenantBilling is enabled without a `persistence.tenantBilling` slice, and these
adapters are missing: subscriptionUsagePort, subscriptionWritePort.

## subscription-bundles

### subscription-bundles.requires-tenant-billing

SubscriptionBundles requires tenantBilling, so the two share authentication and
subscription usage rather than resolving them twice.

### subscription-bundles.requires-repositories

SubscriptionBundles is enabled, but these persistence adapters are missing:
subscriptionBundleRepository, bundleRepository.

## entitlement

### entitlement.requires-adapters

Entitlement active or required by the standard stack, but adapters are missing:
subscriptionRepository, planVersionRepository, transactionRunner.

### entitlement.requires-transactional-persistence

The entitlement stack needs a store that can do transactions, pessimistic
locking, and the persistence bundle declares it cannot. `enforceLimit()` reads a
counter and writes it back; without a transaction and a row lock two concurrent
requests both pass the limit.

## tenant-manifest

### tenant-manifest.requires-plan-resolution

TenantManifest is enabled but nothing can resolve a tenant to a plan, so it
could not filter features. Set `defaultPlanId`, `adapters.planResolver`, or
enable `tenantBilling`.

## Reading a failed boot

```text
SaaSiCatModule.forRoot: 2 configuration problems:
  1. [core.adapters-bound] the core adapters are missing: mfa, rlsBypass. …
     → …/options.md#core
  2. [catalog.requires-persistence] catalog is enabled, but …
     → …/options.md#catalog
```

The list is complete: fixing all of them is one restart, not one per line.
